title: Camp Davis Campground

services.name: camp davis cAMPGROUND
services.desc: Reservations are strongly encouraged; however, we do our best to accommodate everyone! Reservations with a deposit guarantee your preferred site. We have a huge central overflow field so there is always room to accommodate our guests with last-minute travel plans. You are more than welcome to stay on the property and enjoy the facilities after check-out. Please keep in mind that our Foam, Bear, Luminary, Gay Games of Davis, Masquerade, and holiday weekends are very popular. Our sites book early & fill quickly. Two-night minimum stay and a deposit is required on holiday & select theme
